target_api: pointer-parameter dereference inside a function body
post_operation: explicit NULL check on the same pointer parameter (e.g. `if (!p) return -EINVAL;`) executed before any dereference
path_conditions: Inside `rfkill_register(struct rfkill *rfkill)` the parameter is dereferenced at variable initialization `struct device *dev = &rfkill->dev;` BEFORE the `BUG_ON(!rfkill)` check two lines later. Any caller passing NULL hits the dereference first; the NULL check is unreachable when it matters.
